accessToken.label: Access Token
accessToken.help: Your Teslemetry API access token. Get it from https://teslemetry.com/console

region.label: Region
region.help: Tesla API region. Use auto-detect unless you have connection issues.

enableStreaming.label: Enable real-time streaming (SSE)
enableStreaming.help: Use Server-Sent Events for real-time updates. Recommended for best performance.

pollInterval.label: Poll interval (seconds)
pollInterval.help: How often to fetch data when streaming is disabled. Minimum 30 seconds to avoid rate limits.

_deviceSelectionHelp.text: By default, all vehicles and energy sites are included. You can optionally select specific devices to monitor.

selectedVehicles.label: Selected Vehicles (VINs)
selectedVehicles.help: Leave empty to include all vehicles. Add VIN numbers to include only specific vehicles.

selectedEnergySites.label: Selected Energy Sites (IDs)
selectedEnergySites.help: Leave empty to include all energy sites. Add site IDs to include only specific sites.
